messages.subject: Project Falcon - first draft Supply, Software Licence & LTSA
messages.plaintextBody:
Adam,

Following the heads of terms, please find our first draft of the Energy Storage Supply, Software Licence and Long-Term Service Agreement (v1) for Carrowmoor. It tracks the agreed commercial terms. We'd welcome your mark-up. We're targeting signature by end November.

The draft is on the deal site; let me know if you'd prefer it by email.

Best,
James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Thanks - we have it and are reviewing with Catherine's team. Expect our comments early December. At first glance the liability cap and the availability guarantee are the two we'll want to discuss. End-November signing looks ambitious from our side; early-to-mid December is more realistic.

Adam
Denham Lewis LLP
